name: openstem
description: STEM study kit for students: draws circuits, diagrams, graphs and molecules; checks math and units with sympy; reads PDF and Korean HWP lecture files; makes cheat sheets, practice exams, flashcards, slides and lab reports; reads Korean university LMSs. Runs locally, no extra AI cost.

output_dir.title: Output folder / 결과물 폴더
output_dir.description: Where figures and documents are saved. Empty = ~/OpenSTEM

materials_dir.title: Materials folder / 자료 폴더
materials_dir.description: The only folder (besides the output folder) whose files read_document may open. Empty = <output>/자료

lms_school.title: School / 학교 이름
lms_school.description: Optional. Korean university name for the read-only lms tool, e.g. 성균관대

lms_token.title: LMS access token / LMS 액세스 토큰
lms_token.description: Optional. A token you create in your LMS (Canvas: Account > Settings > New Access Token; Moodle: Preferences > Security keys). Never your password.

lms_calendar_url.title: LMS calendar URL / LMS 캘린더 주소
lms_calendar_url.description: Optional. Calendar feed URL for deadlines when your school does not allow tokens
